classification_rules.canonical: Clear owner, stable API/token/route contract, representative usage, and appropriate tests or docs for the layer.
classification_rules.duplicated: Two or more items solve the same UI job; cite call sites and identify the preferred replacement or consolidation target.
classification_rules.legacy: Still used but superseded; include the migration target.
classification_rules.missing: Repeated code, repeated copy, repeated tests, or documented needs imply an absent abstraction, state, fixture, proof, or doc.
classification_rules.intentionally-page-specific: Tied to a named LiveView/page workflow where extraction would leak domain context or reduce clarity.

phoenix_ownership_boundaries.function_components: Preferred primitive shape when attr/slot contracts can define reusable UI.
phoenix_ownership_boundaries.js_hooks: Use for browser interop that Phoenix.LiveView.JS and server-rendered LiveView cannot cover cleanly.
phoenix_ownership_boundaries.css: Token-scoped through the Scoria design system.

rows.name: Canonical Scoria brandbook
rows.next_action: Use brandbook voice and tokens as the operator-grade baseline for Phase 37 lab labels and Phase 38-41 UI polish; verify brand fit, theme parity, microcopy, and evidence-led tone before changing visual language.

rows.name: Scoria semantic CSS tokens
rows.next_action: Keep token changes semantic and prove contrast, focus visibility, theme parity, reduced-motion behavior, and render stability before primitive or page-level changes consume them.

rows.name: Scoria component CSS layer
rows.next_action: Use this as the shared styling owner for primitives and component groups; Phase 38 should prove toast legibility, density/scannability, focus states, and responsive table/list behavior without page-local CSS patches.

rows.name: ScoriaWeb.UI primitive gateway
rows.next_action: Feed Phase 37 with representative states for every primitive; Phase 38 should keep attr/slot contracts, accessible names, keyboard/focus behavior, density, copy affordances, and evidence discoverability consistent.

rows.name: Scoria browser interop hooks
rows.next_action: Inventory hook consumers before changing behavior; Phase 40 should prove command palette, mobile nav, dismissable overlays, copy feedback, theme switching, escape behavior, and focus restoration under keyboard and reduced-motion paths.

rows.name: DS-06 raw palette drift guard
rows.next_action: Keep the guard strict and parseable; Phase 41 should preserve raw-palette-zero proof while adding targeted guardrails for duplicate density controls, inaccessible icon buttons, unreadable toasts, and untested component states.

rows.name: Maintainer design-system and proof docs
rows.next_action: Use Phase 41 to align maintainer docs with the final component lab, proof commands, accessibility/responsive/motion conventions, screenshot limitations, and operator-first page guidance.

rows.name: Screenshot gap register and final proof notes
rows.next_action: Treat screenshots as advisory evidence; Phase 41 should separate fixed issues from deferred proof gaps and only promote visual CI if the screenshot harness becomes deterministic enough.

risks.title: Stale v3.0 proof gaps and partial verification-doc coverage
risks.affected_jtbd_persona_operator_flow: Maintainer needs to distinguish functional UI regressions from missing or partial proof before planning v3.3 guardrails.
risks.mitigation_evidence_target: Phase 41 proof/docs closeout that reconciles v3.0 audit gaps, final gap register limitations, screenshot proof limits, and new regression guardrails.
risks.closeout_proof: Phase 41 summary cites focused ExUnit/browser proof plus final docs explaining fixed issues, accepted limitations, and deferred visual-CI decisions.

risks.title: Approval warning/error toast readability over dense UI
risks.affected_jtbd_persona_operator_flow: Operator rejects or handles an approval and must read immediate feedback over a dense approval inbox without row text competing with toast text.
risks.mitigation_evidence_target: Fold .planning/todos/pending/2026-06-18-make-approval-toasts-legible.md into Phase 38 primitive/control work and prove warning/error toasts remain readable over dense approvals UI in light and dark themes.
risks.closeout_proof: Phase 38 test or browser proof places an approval warning/error toast over dense approval rows and verifies readable text, opaque-enough background, border contrast, and close-button usability.

risks.title: Approval decision history discoverability
risks.affected_jtbd_persona_operator_flow: Operator needs to find approved, denied, rejected, or expired approval decisions later without the UI implying a decided request can be approved in place.
risks.mitigation_evidence_target: Fold .planning/todos/pending/2026-06-20-add-approval-decision-history.md into Phase 39 approvals flow work and prove decided approvals are discoverable with linked run and audit evidence.
risks.closeout_proof: Phase 39 tests show a denied/rejected approval leaves the pending inbox, appears in decision history, exposes request/decision evidence, and cannot be approved in place.

risks.title: Responsive tables/lists and mobile scan paths
risks.affected_jtbd_persona_operator_flow: Operator scans approvals, incidents, datasets, prompts, evals, and evidence on mobile/tablet/desktop without clipped content, trapped scroll, or hidden essential fields.
risks.mitigation_evidence_target: Phase 40 responsive proof across 320, 375, 768, 1024, 1440, and wide desktop widths with table/list scan paths and mobile summaries.
risks.closeout_proof: Phase 40 browser proof records no clipped content, squished essential columns, trapped scroll, or floating controls covering navigation across required widths.

risks.title: Overlay focus, dismissal, motion, and theme parity
risks.affected_jtbd_persona_operator_flow: Keyboard and reduced-motion users need drawers, modals, command palette, mobile nav, copy controls, and theme switching to remain predictable during operator decisions.
risks.mitigation_evidence_target: Phase 40 accessibility, motion, and theme proof for focus trap/restoration, escape and click-outside dismissal, reduced motion, and light/dark/system parity.
risks.closeout_proof: Phase 40 browser and ExUnit proof covers keyboard-only navigation, visible focus, trapped/restored focus, reduced-motion behavior, and theme parity for overlays and shell controls.
